description: NaNi(PO₃)₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pcca space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.13 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.05 Å) and four longer (2.11 Å) Ni-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-58°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.62 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-57°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.63 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NiO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 48°. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and two longer (1.62 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom.
